notes.title: Playtest Is Over 🎮 What’s Next for Bullet Yeeters?
notes.content:
🎮 Streamer Feedback Recap + Playtest Stats 
What’s Next for Bullet Yeeters?

Thank you to everyone who joined our first alpha playtest  your energy and feedback are helping shape the future of Bullet Yeeters.

From May 6 to May 9, we ran our first-ever Twitch Drops Alpha — and the numbers speak for themselves 👇

📊 Playtest Performance (May 6–9, 2025)
[list]
[*] Total Views: 232,092
[*] Live Views: 226,119
[*] Unique Live Viewers: 111,725
[*] Total Unique Viewers: 114,582
[*] Peak Concurrent Viewers: 4,037
[*] Total Hours Watched: 25,775
[*] Unique Streamers: 265
[*] New Wishlists on Steam: 18,000+
[/list]
❤️ What You Loved
[list]
[*] Fast, fun movement and jetpack mechanics
[*] Colorful, polished visuals reminiscent of Fortnite/Brawl Stars
[*] Easy to pick up, fun with friends
[*] Good customization potential
[*] Strong performance even on mid-spec rigs
[/list]
🧪 What Needs Work (And We're Fixing It!)
[list]
[*] Too many bots, not enough PvP  PvP matchmaking is a top priority
[*] Only one game mode  new maps and modes are in development
[*] No custom lobbies  highly requested, coming soon
[*] Confusing upgrade flow  we’re improving UX for agents and weapons
[*] Balance issues  we’re tuning agent power, abilities, and item progression
[/list]
🔧 Coming Soon:
[list]
[*] Team-based modes: 2v2, 3v3 and more
[*] Custom lobbies + Spectator mode
[*] Better matchmaking for real PvP
[*] Reworked UI for upgrades and progression
[*] Creator Codes + referral rewards system
[/list]
🏆 Final Score from Creators?
[list]
[*] 265 streamers joined the playtest
[*] 75% rated the game 4 or 5 out of 5
[*] 66% said they’d recommend it to their friends and viewers
[/list]
Not bad for our very first alpha, right? 😎
And we’re only getting started.

Let’s build the future of Bullet Yeeters together. Join the Discord, share your feedback, and help shape what’s next.

🔗 https://bulletyeeters.com

Yeet, sleep, repeat.

notes.title: Introducing - Bullet Yeeters
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Agents! [/h3]

We’re excited to welcome you to [b]Bullet Yeeters[/b] - a jetpack-powered, toy-scale PvP shooter launching this Spring on Steam (yep, Steam Deck too!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578761/f78ac024f57c82d473abf56461249f5cc849bd48.jpg[/img]

In Bullet Yeeters, you’ll yeet yourself into fast-paced matches across couches, kitchens, and tabletops. Fly with jetpacks, blast with a variety of weapons, and battle it out in wild modes like:

[list]
[*] 🔫 Deathmatch (Team & FFA)
[*] 🌋 Floor is Lava
[*] 👑 Battle Royale
[*] 💥 PvE boss fights vs kaiju-sized enemies
[/list]

Whether you're new to shooters or a seasoned frag-fiend, there's something here for you. Gradually get access to game modes, unlock crazy gear, and customize your tiny warrior with max drip. Want to know a bit more? Then watch the trailer now! 

[previewyoutube=5pYEUsrCeO0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]If you want to support us, hit that Wishlist button to stay updated, and join our Discord to connect with the devs and other players![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578761/d327f2cd478a5b09dd15db1c9403a722ed9e190c.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624020/BULLET_YEETERS/
Much love,
The Bullet Yeeters Team 💛
